caption: Corcoran's Bar and Shop on the main street on a bright winter day. The bar entrance sits in the middle of the building, with the separate shop entrance just to the right. You can see St James Church at the far end of the row.

One of our older concrete planters in front of Corcoran's. Going forward we're filling these with split perennials from our other beds, instead of buying annuals every year. No waste, no spend, and a much better deal for our pollinators (May 2026)
